## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated at the lowest useful layer
- [ ] `cargo fmt --all --check` passes
- [ ] `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` passes
- [ ] `cargo test --workspace` passes
- [ ] `npm run check --prefix frontend` passes
- [ ] `npm run build --prefix frontend` passes
- [ ] `git diff --check` passes
- [ ] License/provenance recorded for new dependencies or assets
- [ ] Documentation and changelog claims match the implementation
